Fake Zoom web client (zen-recorder fixture)

Mimics what the real client does in Firefox: the meeting URL is set from the preview screen on, media connects before admission, peer connections carry only data channels, the remote audio leaves an AudioWorklet through a MediaStreamAudioDestinationNode into an <audio> that is not in the document, every tile is painted by a worker into one canvas in the shadow root of <video-player-container>, muting only changes the audio button, and leaving is a click on the confirmation button, followed by closed connections and, about a second later, a page navigation. Opened at /wc/<number>/start it is the host's side: the host joins alone, and a guest who knocks is counted by the participant counter and named in the Participants button's label until let in (the client's bundle, not verified live).
